shared_elements: upright slab/monolith form with carved decoration on the face
relief carving organized in horizontal registers or zones
justification: Both are upright carved slabs whose faces bear low-relief motifs divided into stacked zones, and both include disc/ring elements, but that is about the extent of the correspondence. A shows a narrative scene of horses, riders and interlaced serpentine animals filling panels, while B shows a schematic anthropomorphic figure with head, ears, arms and body ornaments (rings, a belt-like band) — no animals, no interlace, and an entirely different conception of the carved surface as a body rather than a picture field.
